subject: spaceGalley
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: spaceship galley kitchen.
Style: Alien (1979) Nostromo.
reasoning:
I'm planning a static Nostromo-style galley kitchen prop group with grimy industrial details—beige/grey panels, orange accents, CRT screens, pipes, hanging cables, steel tables, bench seating, lamps, racks, and appliances—keeping the model efficient but visually rich.

For dimensions, I'm sizing the room alcove roughly 3.4m x 2.8m with back and side walls, a floor platform, overhead pipe bundle, and a central table with bench stools, all built with reusable box and cylinder helper functions supporting custom color and orientation, plus a glow kit for the amber light panels.

I'm now detailing the galley fixtures against the back wall: a base cabinet with doors and handles, a four-ring stove, a sink with tap, an extractor hood venting into the ceiling, a coffee machine, an upper shelf stocked with mugs and tins, and a tall fridge/freezer unit with status lights. On the side wall I'm adding a CRT-glow monitor with a menu board and a hatch door with a round window, plus a central steel-top table with a pedestal base.

Still planning the room...

Planning the glow effects for the CRT screen housing, plus a textured plane with menu text rendered via SVG facing inward on the side wall.

Now I'm placing seam strips on the back wall and figuring out the counter, fridge, and side wall layout with a hatch element, working through positions and depths so everything fits without overlap.

Shifting the fridge center and resizing the counter run, I'm laying out four counter door units with evenly spaced centers, adding a stove top with hobs between them, a sink basin with rim and tap on the right unit, and a coffee maker on the left, plus a hood shape above the stove.

Now I'm adding a duct up to the ceiling, an upper shelf with mugs, tins, and cans, and setting up a table with a slab top, dark edge trim, and a two-legged pedestal base.

Table items include trays, mugs, a salt shaker, a meal tray, and a bowl, plus benches with cushions positioned on either side. I'm figuring out a hanging lamp with a shade and glow bulb, deciding to simplify the ceiling to beams and pipes instead of a full panel so the overhead view stays open, then starting on the floor plate.

Adding floor grating strips...

Now I'm placing the side wall details: a hatch door with frame and round window, a fridge unit, and a monitor screen positioned along the wall's z-axis.
